summary.en: The board dims, the camera pushes onto the token bar, and its own count grows into the enlarged result line; the bar lights in the learned colour.
summary.zh: 棋盘暗下，镜头推向词元条，条上的计数本身放大成结果那一行；词元条亮成“学到的”颜色。

fits: The result of a run, grown out of the through-line object rather than cut to a stat card.
notFor: Results with no through-line on screen; more than one number.

intent.en: The result grows out of the object that carried the run, so the number is earned rather than announced.
intent.zh: 结果从一直承载运行的那个对象里长出来，数字是赚来的，不是宣布的。

content.en: The run; one result line with marked numbers (≤ 40 / 16 字).
content.zh: 运行输入；一行结果，数字可标色（≤ 40 字符 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 运行的结果，从贯穿线索对象里长出来，而不是切到数据卡。

notFor.zh: 屏上没有贯穿线索的结果；超过一个数字。

en: The camera push is 1.3 at most; more and the board's top rows clip.
zh: 推镜最多 1.3 倍；再大板子顶部几行会被裁掉。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
